claims.claim: Capital One's 2025 10-K defines Diners Club International as a network of licensees (generally financial institutions) that issue cards and/or provide acceptance, i.e. a franchise model with no direct membership tiers published.
claims.quote: Diners Club is a global payments network of licensees, which are generally financial institutions, that issue Diners Club-branded charge cards
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: join. Post-acquisition filing (Capital One closed Discover on May 18, 2025); Diners Club is grouped with Discover Network, PULSE and Network Partners as the 'Global Payment Network'.

claims.claim: Outside the US the network owner issues no cards and does not set the terms of cards issued by Diners Club licensees or network-alliance participants, so product terms are franchisee-determined.
claims.quote: Outside of the United States, we do not issue cards that are accepted on our networks, and we do not determine the terms and conditions
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: join. Sentence continues: 'of cards issued by our international network participants, whether they are Diners Club participants or work with us through a network alliance.'

claims.claim: Capital One lists building and keeping a strong base of Diners Club network licensees and meaningful global acceptance as a named risk factor for its international network business.
claims.quote: our ability to create and maintain a strong base of network licensees and achieving meaningful global card acceptance
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: join. Also: 'Internationally, American Express competes in the same market segments as Diners Club.'

claims.claim: The Diners Club issuing page on discoverglobalnetwork.com offers an 'exclusive issuer' position per market, footnoted as non-exclusive in select markets, and the only application step is an email to DCIBrand@discover.com; no fees, eligibility criteria or timeline are published.
claims.title: Diners Club International Issuing | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Page also promises 'Strategic support and guidance', 'Product co-creation', 'Turnkey marketing programs with local flexibility'.

claims.claim: Diners Club markets its ATM footprint to prospective issuers as more than 1.2M ATMs in over 130 countries and territories.
claims.quote: Diners Club is accepted at more than 1.2M ATMs in over 130 countries and territories
claims.title: Diners Club International Issuing | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. dinersclub.com separately claims acceptance 'across more than 185 countries and territories' (merchant acceptance figure, not ATM).

claims.claim: dinersclub.com's business card-programs page routes prospective country partners to a generic contact form rather than a published application process.
claims.quote: Want to partner with us? Let's work together to offer these products in your country.
claims.title: Card Programs | Diners Club International
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Note /business/ returns 404; the live path is /businesses/.

claims.claim: The Discover Global Network fintech programme describes a sponsor model built from BIN sponsors, processors and program managers, but publishes no steps, timeline or fees.
claims.quote: We bring together a powerful combination of payments capabilities and partnerships, including BIN Sponsors, Processors, and Program Managers to enable your program.
claims.title: Fintech Partnerships | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Named example fintechs: Wellthi, Finexio, Mystifly. No Diners-specific fintech track shown.

claims.claim: Merchant acceptance of Diners Club/Discover Global Network is enabled through the merchant's existing acquirer; the network publishes a find-an-acquirer page rather than a direct merchant sign-up.
claims.quote: Please contact your current payments provider to start accepting Discover Global Network.
claims.title: Accept Discover Global Network | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Find-an-acquirer at /resources/businesses/find-an-acquirer/; POS check at /resources/businesses/check-your-card-reader/.

claims.claim: Discover runs a type-approval programme whose output is a public Partner Directory of certified products; the certification process itself is not described publicly.
claims.quote: This list only contains specific products that have been type approved by Discover.
claims.title: Partner Directory | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Disclaimer on page: 'DFS MAKES NO WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED AS TO THE SPECIFICATIONS, THE PROCESS BY WHICH ANY PRODUCTS ARE TESTED OR APPROVED.'

claims.claim: Moorwand Ltd added UK merchant acquiring to an existing Diners Club issuing relationship in December 2025, with acceptance spanning Discover, Diners Club and 30 network alliance partners.
claims.quote: accept cards from Discover®, Diners Club International®, and 30 network alliance partners
claims.title: Moorwand Ltd expands its Diners Club International collaboration to include UK merchant acquiring
claims.publisher: Diners Club International Club Connections (Capital One)
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Post-acquisition. No onboarding timeline or certification detail disclosed.

claims.claim: ISX Financial launched a flykk-branded Diners Club International debit card in select EU markets on September 24, 2026, the most recent published issuer onboarding.
claims.quote: The flykk debit card is now available to users in select markets in the EU
claims.title: The new flykk Diners Club International Debit Card by ISX Financial
claims.publisher: Diners Club International Club Connections (Capital One)
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: join. Other Club Connections partner items: Uzcard alliance (2026), Sparkasse Pay Slovenia, BRAC Bank (2025), Nium and Pax2pay (2025).

claims.claim: The Discover Developer Center (linked from dinersclub.com as 'Developer Portal') exposes no API list, sandbox, test cards, SDKs, auth scheme, webhooks or changelog when logged out; it is a login gateway with Contact Us and FAQ.
claims.quote: Welcome to the Discover® Developer Center
claims.title: Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: developer. Logged-out product count: 0 visible. /products returns 404. Page points to 'Enablement Resources' via an external partner link. developer.discoverglobalnetwork.com does not resolve.

claims.claim: Discover Global Network's public acquirer interchange page is a country selector offering only United States and Canada schedules; no Diners Club International interchange or cross-border schedule is published there.
claims.quote: Discover® Acquirer Interchange and Cash Reimbursement Rates and Fees
claims.title: Acquirer Interchange Pricing | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: pricing. Reached via redirect from https://www.discoverglobalnetwork.com/interchange/. Options seen: 'United States - English', 'Canada - English', 'Commerçants Canadiens - Française'. Country pages not fetched (budget).

claims.claim: Issuer interchange on Diners Club transactions is contractually negotiated per issuing organisation and volume-based, not a published schedule.
claims.quote: on certain transactions on the Diners Club and PULSE networks. This cost is contractually established and is based on the card issuing organization's transaction volume.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: pricing. Full sentence begins 'We pay issuer interchange to card issuing entities that have entered into contractual arrangements to issue cards on the Discover Network and'.

claims.claim: Capital One flags that debit transactions on its three-party networks (Discover/Diners/PULSE) are outside Fed Regulation II today but could be brought into scope, which would erase most anticipated network revenue synergies.
claims.quote: debit card transactions on three-party networks could become subject to the Federal Reserve's Regulation II
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: pricing/regulator. 10-K also records: 'In August 2025, a North Dakota district court ruled that the Federal Reserve exceeded its statutory authority when it originally promulgated Regulation II in 2011.' (vacatur stayed pending appeal; Kentucky court upheld).

claims.claim: Operating rules, technical specifications and enablement resources for Discover/Diners partners sit behind the Discover Service Center login; no public rulebook, edition or page count was found.
claims.quote: Find certified partners worldwide with solutions to help expand your business.
claims.title: Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: rules. Home page 'Log In' links to https://servicecenter.discovernetwork.com/loginlogout/exec/loginForm.do. Public sections named: Fraud & Security (/solutions/fraud-security/), PCI Compliance (/solutions/pci-compliance/). No bulletin, mandate or dispute-framework names visible logged out.
